name: dev.altai.npcforge
description: Character + dialogue engine for Unity. Full npcforge generator inside the Editor: NPC Browser, State Inspector, Relationship Graph, In-Editor Dialogue Preview, one-click scene setup, asset postprocessor that auto-wires new Yarn files into your Yarn Project, custom inspectors, save/load, and both IMGUI and UI Toolkit panels. Runtime drops Yarn Spinner dialogue, reactive barks, time-of-day greetings, and lines.csv straight into your Assets folder.

samples.description: One-click scene scaffolding for the sample tavern demo, plus example scripts for proximity barks and autosave wiring.
